story_binding.name: PUCT rulemaking petition gate

layers.name: Statutory petition right
layers.function: Lets an interested person ask a state agency to adopt a rule and starts a 60 day clock on the agency.

layers.name: Petition form rule
layers.controller: Public Utility Commission of Texas rule 16 TAC 22.281
layers.function: Sets what a petition must contain, including complete proposed rule text, before it counts as a rulemaking petition.

layers.name: Staff intake and comment window
layers.controller: Commission Rules and Projects Division staff
layers.function: Opens a project number for the petition and sets the public comment deadline.

layers.name: Staff recommendation
layers.function: Screens the petition and comments against form, authority and workload, then recommends deny or initiate.

layers.name: Commission order
layers.function: Records the deny or initiate decision in a signed written order.

story_binding.decision: deny the petition in writing or initiate a rulemaking proceeding

metaphor_limit: Editorial metaphor, not an engineering drawing
concept: A bound sheaf of pages stands at a heavy slab that closes one bay of a wall, while the neighbouring bay stands open onto an empty lit passage. One wall, two bays, and the written answer decides which one the sheaf meets.
